title: neottia makinoana
intro: Neottia makinoana, commonly known as Makino's tongue orchid, is a type of orchid species that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used in East Asian herbal medicine. Neottia makinoana is known to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Neottia makinoana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and cardiovascular protective effects.
